purpose: Hoist repeated nearest-neighbor horizontal confidence-mask indices out of the row loop, with an identity-width path and exact mask/admission parity.

contract.math: Preserve strict >0.5 threshold, floor(x*sourceWidth/width), floor(y*sourceHeight/height), binary bytes, all 1..320 dimensions, Float32Array checks and complete source finite/range validation before output allocation. Identity width uses the exact x index; other widths compute one Uint16 horizontal map per call. No retained map cache; at most 640 additional logical index bytes.
contract.ownership: Every result remains a fresh Uint8Array with caller-independent storage that can be transferred/detached. No signature, SDK/model/worker protocol, Rust tracker, gray conversion, explicit GPU/CPU readback or dependency change.
contract.verification: Run new independent frozen-parent mask controls on parent and candidate, exhaustive horizontal size pairs, small one-hot supports, strict float boundaries, unsampled invalid values and buffer transfer/ownership. Keep all existing browser/WASM/model controls and add actual-browser module parity controls. Compare all mask bytes and all timing rows in two balanced Node surveys, retaining adverse results and making no physical-phone, GPU or end-to-end speed claim.
contract.preservation: Preserve all previous camera/renderer files including the completed isolated Cargo target, 493 scientific JSON, 42 frozen native artifacts, room/reference outputs, shared raw WASM/cache, current tracker WASM and resolved lock. No Rust compilation, sensor reads/acquisition, vendor/model/browser/toolchain downloads or payload copies.

resources.strategy: Reuse the exact tested current Rust WASM and nine hash-checked vendor hardlinks. Fresh owned E-drive site/logs only. Strict read-only inventory and hash-preserve all prior roots; fail closed on storage or source changes.

benchmark.comparison: Use one fixed confidence pattern including exact/adjacent Float32 threshold values. Check every timed output against the independent frozen parent outside the timer. Publish all raw samples, both survey ratios and adverse rows. No affinity, frequency, other-host-load or GC control and no confidence intervals.

remaining_80_percent: Measured calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying physical Linux hardware and integrated operational acceptance remain open.
